newsitem.title: BELGIUM: RESEARCH ALERT- KB rates Generale Bank "reduce".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- KB rates Generale Bank "reduce".

text.p: Belgian brokerage KB Securities, a unit of Belgian bank Kredietbank, said in a research note released on Wednesday that investors should reduce their holdings of Belgium's biggest bank Generale Bank .
Generale Bank was at 14,275 francs when the report was prepared on June 23 and closed at that level on Wednesday after climbing during the day.
KB rates shares "reduce" when it believes they will underperform the Bel-20 index .BFX by up to five percent over the next year.

KB said speculation about a Big Belgian Bank merger, which had supported Generale Bank's share price in recent months, was waning and capital gains on the bank's investment portfolio would be depressed in 1997 by the stable low interest rate environment.
In 1996 they contributed 13.1 billion francs to the bank's commission income of 26.2 billion francs, KB said.
"When taking into account the above mentioned elements combined with the earnings prospects for Generale Bank, we believe investors should reduce their exposure to Generale Bank," KB said.
